cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
from language import load, validate
from checker import check, Checker, Function
from interpreter import run

p = load(open('witness.json').read())
print("nodes:", validate(p))
print("check:", check(p))
r = run(p)
print("run:", r['status'], r['message'], "steps:", r['steps'])

# Show the checker's final belief about g (instrumented)
c = Checker(p)
env = {n: __import__('checker').scalar(__import__('language').kind(v)) for n,v in p['inputs'].items()}
facts = {n: __import__('checker').scalar(__import__('language').kind(d['value'])) for n,d in p['cells'].items()}
c.block(p['body'], env, facts)
g = env['g']
print("checker g writes (top):", sorted(g.writes), " nested (result) writes:", sorted(g.result.writes))
print("checker facts:", {k: sorted(v) for k,v in facts.items()})
EOF

mkdir -p /tmp/verify && cp /app/language.py /app/checker.py /app/interpreter.py /app/evaluate.py /tmp/verify/ && cp /app/witness.json /tmp/verify/ && cd /tmp/verify && python3 evaluate.py witness.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('accepted:',d['accepted'],'status:',d['status'],'message:',d['message'],'steps:',d['steps'])"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/app/witness.json'));print('keys:',sorted(d));print('cells:',list(d['cells']));print('stmts in body:',len(d['body']),'in loop block:',len(d['body'][3][2]))"
